What you expected to happen instead.

**PGN files involved**
If the bug depends on a specific PGN file, please describe its structure
(size, whether it has variations/NAGs/SetUp-FEN games/unusual encodings,
etc.) rather than attaching real/private game data if you can avoid it.
PGN Studio is designed to keep everything local - please only attach a
file if you are comfortable sharing it publicly on GitHub.

**Logs**
If available, attach or paste relevant log excerpts (see `SECURITY.md` if
the issue might have security impact - please report those privately
instead).
